newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Nauticalink in ferry venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Nauticalink in ferry venture.

text.p: Ferry operator Nauticalink Bhd said on Friday that it has agreed to participate as a 49 percent joint venture partner in a ferry service with Penang Port Sdn Bhd.

In a statement, Nauticalink said the equity interest in the venture is worth 20 million ringgit. The venture with the northern island port company is for a ferry service between Pangkalan Sultan Abdul Halim and Pangkalan Raja Tun Uda.
Nauticalink said the proposed venture is expected to enhance its earnings in the future and to strengthen its position in the ferry services business.
